scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w mint-server" "npm run dev -w mint-client"
scripts.test: npm test -w mint-server && npm test -w mint-client && npm test -w agent-eval
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w mint-server && npm run typecheck -w mint-client
scripts.build: npm run build -w mint-server && npm run build -w agent-eval && npm run build -w mint-client
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build -w mint-server && npm run electron:rebuild && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w mint-client" "sleep 3 && cd apps/electron && npx electron ."
scripts.electron:dev:server: npm run build -w mint-server && npm run electron:rebuild && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w mint-server" "npm run dev -w mint-client" "sleep 3 && cd apps/electron && npx electron ."
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build -w mint-server && ELECTRON=true npm run build -w mint-client && cd apps/electron && npm run build:mac --
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:server && npm run lint:fix:client
scripts.eval:agent: npm run build -w mint-server && npm run build -w agent-eval && node scripts/with-node-version.cjs node apps/agent-eval/dist/cli.js
